acceptanceCriteria: A Vitest receipt whose test is declared in committed source yields a present location at the declaration line, or a typed absence only when discovery is ambiguous; covered by a test.
body: Residual from V1-2045 (PR #1319). For unprofiled runners and Vitest the receipt anchor is a failure frame, not the declaration, so location file/line is absent with reason anchor-not-declaration unless source discovery places it (internal/testvaliditydoc/location_discover_test.go). Expected: the declaring file and line.

title: Unprofiled and Vitest test-validity anchors are failure frames, so the location is absent with anchor-not-declaration
